Two companies, Manipal Health and Moneyview, get SEBI IPO approval

Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has granted approval for Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) to two companies: Temasek-backed Manipal Health and Moneyview. Chandan Steel also received approval to raise funds via IPO. Manipal Health is reportedly eyeing a July listing.
